title: Landscape and Taxonomy of Prompt Engineering Patterns in Software Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2611.29853v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Advancements in large language models (LLMs) have enhanced their ability to handle ambiguous user instructions. However, effective prompt patterns remain crucial for usability and comprehension. This article presents a taxonomy of prompt engineering patterns for software engineering. It is based on a systematic literature review that was conducted in early 2023, when LLMs still faced significant limitations in context length and inference capabilities. Our study explores techniques that enhance the usability and reliability of LLMs, emphasizing the ongoing importance of well-designed prompts in optimizing task performance. Our findings highlight the critical role of prompt patterns in maximizing LLM's potential, even as their capabilities continue to evolve.

translated_title: 软件工程中提示工程模式的全景与分类法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的进步增强了其处理模糊用户指令的能力。然而，有效的提示模式对于可用性和可理解性仍然至关重要。本文提出了一个面向软件工程的提示工程模式分类法。该分类法基于2023年初进行的一项系统性文献综述，当时大语言模型在上下文长度和推理能力方面仍存在显著局限。我们的研究探讨了提升大语言模型可用性和可靠性的技术，强调了精心设计的提示在优化任务性能方面持续的重要性。我们的发现突出了提示模式在最大化大语言模型潜力方面的关键作用，即使其能力仍在不断演进。
tldr: 本文基于系统性文献综述提出了软件工程领域提示工程模式的分类法，表明即使大语言模型能力持续增强，精心设计的提示模式对于提升其可用性、可靠性和任务性能仍然至关重要。
